title: S012 — Fold-state delta productionization / forcedBy identity
description: S011 PASS left two engineering questions: (1) the fold-state observation had excessive overhead (2.2x at H=10 -> 57.7x at H=3000); (2) forcedBy identity semantics were undefined before exposing a production-facing delta API. S012 resolves both.

forcedby_contract.represents: the SET of targets a forceEvent has been applied to
forcedby_contract.presence: semantic — drives truth and force-vs-* contradictions
forcedby_contract.value: the content-derived intervention id `forceEvent:<target>` — a bijection of the key; used only as ConflictNote.source (provenance), which the semantic projection subtracts
forcedby_contract.identity_domain: none distinct; no new identity domain invented
forcedby_contract.evidence: a hand-built id `forceEvent:custom-xyz` yields the SAME stateHash (f0185e63); every forcedBy value equals `forceEvent:<key>` on verrin and ordos; repeated FORCE yields an empty delta

result_summary: PASS. (1) forcedBy identity resolved as above. (2) Delta overhead reduced by replacing S011's per-intervention canonicalJson(current) whole-list serialization with factListsEqual — a field-by-field structural comparison of the fold's own output (no serialization, no semantic rule). Overhead is now 0.15-0.29x (H=10), 0.74x (H=1000), 0.93x (H=3000), 1.02x (H=10000) — about 63x better than S011 at H=3000 and stable per intervention. Correctness unchanged: S009/S010 witnesses caught with no special cases; 520/520 differential retention on verrin, ordos and the multi-fact overlap canon; 0 inverse-attack hits; category classification identical to S011 (A=19990 B=621 C=2692 D=14329); determinism and branch isolation pass. Default behavior preserved: 624/624 tests, verify-facts 3/3, frozen hashes e4c79cec/51f32b2e unchanged, stateHash for FORCE->NEGATE = 1a8fe542.
api_boundary: Experimental API, not production. The retention rule built on the delta remains an experiment (category C over-retention is unresolved). Keep buildModel as the production surface. If a forcedBy accessor is exposed, expose presence only (a Set view), never the id.
limitations: Over-retention (category C, 2692 steps) unresolved; no minimality claim.
Empirical only (520/520, 0 inverse hits) — no formal proof.
H > 10000 not measured; bounded by the pre-existing fold's O(H x facts) scan in overrideFact, not by the delta.
Small-H overhead ratios below 1.0 are measurement noise.
